name: Goi ca
summary: Goi ca is a raw fish salad with herbs, green onion, and roasted rice. In Da Nang the herring plate, gỏi cá trích, is a city lunch. Gỏi cá Nam Ô is the north-shore plate, toward Hai Van.
origin: The central coast. Nam O village, on the way to Hai Van, is the old address for the fish salad. Herring salad is also served in town on Trần Cao Vân.
howToEat: Eat it as a shared plate with the herb pile and the dip. It is not a noodle soup.
Order the Trần Cao Vân herring salad when you are already in the city.
Ride to Nam O only when the north shore is already the plan. Do not detour for one salad on a beach day.
The 18 May 2020 city page says the Nam Ô fish is dressed as soon as it is landed, the fish smell is taken off, and the dipping sauce is made for this salad.
where: Gỏi cá trích is on Trần Cao Vân. The page has the street and not a shop number. Gỏi cá Nam Ô is in Nam O, on the shore toward Hai Van.
seoTitle: Goi ca — herring salad in Da Nang
seoDescription: Goi ca trich is herring salad on Tran Cao Van in Da Nang. Goi ca Nam O is the north-shore plate toward Hai Van. Order either as a shared lunch, not a noodle soup.
